study: JRS records study continuation: 0.3.5 research candidate (0.3.4 compiler, corrected prompt), live model run, arm L2
status: PROPOSED. Not authorized. Live dispatch is disabled in this build.

continuation.pooling: Never pooled. L2 is a separate arm with a changed prompt; L1 and L2 are reported side by side, never as one unchanged run.
continuation.old_authorization: RUN-LIVE-AUTH-20261028-01 does not cover this plan (different study name, candidate, prompt, plan and record set hashes; listed as never valid).
continuation.human_labels: Not required for technical preparation or execution. Human agreement stays unmeasured until imported labels exist.

engine_of_record: 0.3.1-candidate (unchanged; this run tests 0.3.5 without adopting it)

PRE.purpose: Provider compatibility only: contract adherence, quotation verification, latency and cost on three records. Says nothing about Engine quality.

RUN.purpose: The study: every eligible record, three repeats, scored against the AI-proposed references and, where recorded, human labels. Repeats measure run-to-run variation.

TGT.purpose: The two known weaknesses with a real model: a stated but irrelevant basis (42 UNGROUNDED records) and direct or indirect instructions in the record (22 phrasings, one flawed and one clean base).

stop_rules.SR-01: the credential variable named in the authorization is absent (found at the gate, before the request is sent)
stop_rules.SR-02: the authorization does not verify against the frozen plan (checked before the first request)
stop_rules.SR-05: HTTP 504 or any other unexpected status
stop_rules.SR-06: a network error or timeout that remains after the retries
stop_rules.SR-07: three consecutive requests that end on 429, 500 or 529 after their retries, or a retry-after beyond the 20-second window
stop_rules.SR-08: a refusal in PRE; the third refusal in RUN or TGT
stop_rules.SR-09: a truncated response in PRE; in RUN or TGT, three or more truncations that are also at least 5% of completed requests
stop_rules.SR-10: in RUN or TGT, ten or more responses that fail the quote-only contract that are also more than 25% of completed requests
stop_rules.SR-11: a guard violation, mechanical-check failure or graph-validation failure when a capture is compiled offline
stop_rules.SR-12: the spend cap, request cap or attempt cap is reached
stop_rules.SR-13: reported input tokens above the frozen upper estimate
stop_rules.SR-14: a response model identifier different from the authorized model
stop_rules.SR-15: a capture refused because it contains a credential value or a credential-shaped string
stop_rules.SR-16: a request found in an ambiguous state (sent with no outcome) on resume
stop_rules.SR-18: any refusal by the sender gate or the authorization (stops before the request)

pre_gate: All three PRE requests complete with HTTP 200; at least two of the three return a valid quote-only contract that compiles offline with no guard, mechanical or graph-validation failure; no stop rule fires; spend within the PRE cap.

capture.location: A private directory outside the repository and outside any git working tree, named in the authorization (retention_location). The command refuses any other location.
capture.format: One JSON file per request, written once, mode 0600. JOURNAL.jsonl: append-only, hash-chained, each entry written through before the request leaves.
capture.committed: Only hashes, counts and derived results. No response text, no request body beyond its hash, no credential.
capture.provider_side: Anthropic commercial policy (checked 2026-10-28): inputs and outputs deleted within 30 days by default; flagged content up to 2 years; zero-data-retention agreements override. The account arrangement is NOT ESTABLISHED and is confirmed by the owner in the authorization.

scoring.arm: L2: the captured response compiled offline by the frozen 0.3.5 continuation candidate (0.3.4 compiler) with the research profile; scorer version 2
scoring.references: AI-proposed references (agreement, never accuracy); human labels only where recorded, reported separately
